title: トーセンジョーダン登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan is bit of a ditz. Because of that, her teachers often get the wrong idea about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But her friends know that, despite being held back by her fragile toenails, she wants to win and works harder than anyone to that end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And then there are those who, for unknown reasons, enjoy confusing Jordan with their antics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At any rate, Tosen Jordan and I are ready to begin our journey to take on the Twinkle Series!
